notes.parts: Neuron parts are each feature's largest positive decoder weights (up to 4, each >= 0.1), computed by figure_sources/sae-last-layer/build.py from decoder_rows.json; each part's image is that neuron's top positive validation image. Negative weights are omitted for clarity.
notes.overlay: Expanded view: 8 top images per feature and 4 top images per neuron part or match, all 224x224 crops of the model's center view (the source cache is 256px; no higher-resolution originals).
